column1: # Dinucleotide DNA shape / deformability scales.
# Source: IIT Madras SBFE table of 16 DNA physico-chemical properties,
#   https://www.iitm.ac.in/bioinfo/SBFE/physico_dna.html (retrieved 2026-10-02),
#   itself compiled from DiProDB (Friedel et al., Nucleic Acids Res 37:D37, 2009).
# Underlying primary scales: gel-mobility bending propensity (Brukner et al.,
#   EMBO J 14:1812, 1995); conformational flexibility and elastic force
#   constants from B-DNA crystal structures (Olson et al., PNAS 95:11163, 1998).
# Sign/units are as published there; only ratios and spreads are used downstream.
# Thermodynamic scales from the same table are deliberately excluded: duplex
#   dH/dS/dG/Tm are already covered by features/d_mechanics.py. The
#   nucleosome-occupancy scale is excluded as eukaryote-only.
scale
flex_shift
flex_slide
bend_major
bend_minor
stiff_rise
stiff_roll
stiff_shift
stiff_slide
stiff_tilt
stiff_twist
# Two anomalies in the source table, left as fetched here and handled in
# features/i_shape.py so the decisions are reviewable:
#   stiff_roll  AA/TT and GA/TC are 0.02 while every other step is 16-26.
#               Treated as corrupt and excluded from the feature build.
#   bend_major, bend_minor  not reverse-complement symmetric (e.g. AA 1.18 vs
#               TT 1.09), which a duplex step property must be. Symmetrised by
#               averaging each step with its reverse complement before use.
